own_solution.law: Energy and longitudinal momentum conservation give Ef + Eb = K + 2mc² and Ef - Eb = sqrt(K(K + 2mc²)). Therefore Ef = [K + 2mc² + sqrt(K(K + 2mc²))]/2. With mc² = 511 keV, the answers for K = 800, 870, 930 and 1040 keV are respectively 1514.66, 1587.49, 1649.68 and 1763.20 keV.
